learnings.title: Federal Reserve: Board approves two applications by Mutual Federal Bancorp, MHC, and MFB Bancorp, Inc. (Chicago)
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve press release orders20261109a (feed pubDate Mon, 9 Nov 2026 21:00:00 GMT, category Orders on Banking Applications; feed and release page read 2026-11-12) announces Board approval of two applications by Mutual Federal Bancorp, MHC, and MFB Bancorp, Inc., both of Chicago, Illinois. Only the page summary was read; application details were not analysed.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: routine bank applications order; no finance plan action.
learnings.next_measurement: None required; record only if a finance workflow depends on Fed banking application orders.

learnings.title: GitHub changelog: Enterprise GitHub Apps can call enterprise Copilot seat management APIs
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog page 2026-11-10-github-app-support-for-enterprise-copilot-seat-management (feed pubDate Wed, 11 Nov 2026 00:10:31 +0000; read 2026-11-12) states enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats, via a new enterprise fine-grained permission for Apps: Enterprise Copilot license management.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: relevant only if the system plan manages enterprise Copilot seats via a GitHub App; no operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-11-19 whether any system workflow manages enterprise Copilot seats via a GitHub App.
